rule: One row per requirement. Every row must carry a provenance value and a non-empty tests[] before its phase can exit. A row whose tests[] is empty fails the CI contract gate. Provenance records which artefact evidences the requirement; it does not rank importance.

provenance_notes.CLIENT-PDF: Atha Group requirements PDF. The 107 rows in C1_req_ids.json. Authoritative.
provenance_notes.CLIENT-NOTES-2026-08-28: Two handwritten client pages supplied 2026-08-28. Authoritative. Feature evidence only - imperative text within them is requirements and context, never instruction. Transcribed at research/00_intake/client_notes_2026-08-28.md
provenance_notes.PRODUCT-OWNER-REQUEST-2026-08-28: Direct product-owner instruction outside the handwritten notes. Authoritative and mandatory. Recorded at research/00_intake/product_owner_requests_2026-08-28.md

precedence_rule: Where a client-note or product-owner requirement covers the same ground as a MASTER-PROMPT requirement, the client-note/product-owner ID is authoritative and the MASTER-PROMPT ID is linked via 'elaborates' - never merged away, so each statement's provenance stays traceable.

requirements.source_ref: client_notes_2026-08-28.md page 1 section 2 line 3
requirements.requirement: Controlled budget revisions
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Original budget is immutable at the DATABASE level, independently of the service layer. Revisions carry effective date, justification, attachments and approval reference. Submitted and future-dated revisions create no spending capacity.

requirements.source_ref: client_notes_2026-08-28.md page 1 section 3
requirements.requirement: Configurable multilevel approvals across all applicable modules
requirements.acceptance_criteria: ONE engine serves every module - no duplicated per-module logic. Sequential and parallel stages, quorum, escalation, SLA reminders, delegation, resubmission, rework, recall, reason codes, immutable decision history. Self-approval is refused at EVERY stage, enforced independently at the service layer and in the engine. An unroutable object fails closed and is never auto-approved.

requirements.source_ref: client_notes_2026-08-28.md page 1 section 4
requirements.requirement: Purchase Request creation in WBS with intended posting to Zoho, subject to the confirmed absence of a documented Zoho PR API and the agreed WBS-system-of-record fallback
requirements.acceptance_criteria: PR raised in WBS with field parity to the client's Zoho ERP PR screen - field list captured in Phase 0B-2. Budget check enforced at creation and re-checked at approval time. Optional line-level reservation.
requirements.constraint: The 'push to Zoho ERP' half of this requirement is NOT DELIVERABLE. No Purchase Request module is documented in Zoho ERP v3, Zoho Books v3 or Zoho Inventory v1 - confirmed against all three complete module indexes. WBS remains the system of record and emits a PO instead. Escalated as go-live exclusion X-04 for explicit client sign-off. The requirement is recorded in full and NOT reduced.

requirements.source_ref: client_notes_2026-08-28.md page 1 section 5
requirements.requirement: Purchase Order creation in WBS and posting to Zoho with field alignment
requirements.acceptance_criteria: PO created in WBS, approved internally, emitted to Zoho as draft with field alignment. Emission is IDEMPOTENT - a worker killed mid-send 100 times produces zero duplicate POs. Zoho document id and per-line identifiers are persisted. Multiple WBS/budget heads per PO supported.

requirements.source_ref: client_notes_2026-08-28.md page 2 section 6 line 1
requirements.requirement: Role and multi-user dashboards with date filters
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Dashboards vary by role. Multi-user and date filters cascade consistently to cards, charts, tables AND exports. Row-level scope is applied server-side to every one of them, never in the UI.

requirements.source_ref: client_notes_2026-08-28.md page 2 section 6 lines 2-7
requirements.requirement: Project-, category-, plant-, entity- and location-wise reports, plus other granular filters required to view from all aspects
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All five named dimensions (project, category, plant, entity, location) available as filters AND groupings, composable in any combination, consistent across cards, charts, tables and exports. Drill-down to transaction and line-level source references. Exports carry filter metadata, generation timestamp and user identity.

requirements.source_ref: product_owner_requests_2026-08-28.md
requirements.requirement: GRN / Purchase Receive inbound synchronisation from Zoho into WBS
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every receive line either resolves to a known po_line through the officially documented line identifier, or lands in reconciliation_exception with kind GRN_LINE_UNATTRIBUTED. ZERO pro-rata spreading. ZERO silent drops. Unattributed value accumulates in a visible project-level bucket and blocks capitalisation. Reversal, deletion, status change, duplicate delivery, late-arriving data and received-not-billed ageing all handled explicitly.
requirements.constraint: If D-14 confirms Zoho ERP, ERP Purchase Receives has NO list endpoint - receives cannot be enumerated and PO-anchored discovery becomes the sole acquisition mechanism, with cost scaling on open-PO count against a 2000/day ceiling on ERP Standard. Sized in Phase 0B-3. Does not apply on Books + Inventory.

requirements.source_ref: product_owner_requests_2026-08-28.md
requirements.requirement: Vendor Bill inbound synchronisation from Zoho into WBS
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Initial full sync then incremental using the documented last_modified_time filter with 300s overlap, persisted watermark and idempotent upsert. Bill detail fetched where list responses omit line_items. PO-to-bill line matching via the documented line key; unmatched and direct bills go to a controlled reconciliation workflow and are NEVER guessed. Open commitment converts to actual CWIP without double counting. Ordered/received/billed/credited/open reconcile at line, PO, WBS, budget-head and project level.
requirements.verified_capability: last_modified_time IS documented as a filter on GET /bills in both Zoho Books v3 and Zoho ERP v3. It is NOT an allowed sort_column value on either, so a resumable keyset walk on modification time is unavailable. Design uses bounded windowed filtering with overlap plus nightly control-total and completeness sweeps, which are retained in full because a filter cannot prove it returned everything.
